change.description: Separate user archive state from missing Compose records and add an authenticated single-record purge flow for missing Stack records.

planned.reasoning: The API adds state filtering, explicit missing fields, and authenticated preview/delete routes without removing existing routes. The migration adds durable audit state and converts legacy missing archive reasons into an explicit missing state; older minor versions are not required to interpret the new state.

scope_drift.description: The implementation remains within the approved additive API and explicit persistent-state migration scope.

current.reasoning: Existing clients continue to receive the existing Stack fields and routes; missing records are intentionally excluded from the default list and can be requested explicitly with state=missing or state=all. The candidate reads pre-migration databases through the migration and retains existing Stack IDs when Compose files return.

verified.reasoning: The public API and persistent-state compatibility behavior are covered by the full Rust suite, migration tests, API contract tests, and current-head CI evidence; no existing route was removed and Docker/Compose resources remain outside the record deletion boundary.

public_api.supported_consumer_range: Dockrev 0.81.x and later releases in the same major version.
evidence: GET /api/stacks remains available with the existing response envelope; state=present is the explicit default and state=missing|all are additive filters.
GET /api/stacks/{id}/record-deletion-preview and DELETE /api/stacks/{id} require the existing authenticated user boundary and return conflict responses for ineligible records.

persistent_state.state_description: Migration 0043 adds stack_record_deletion_audits and migrates legacy missing archive reasons to discovered status=missing while preserving user archive state. Successful deletion retains only minimal audit metadata; backup artifact details remain only while cleanup is pending.
persistent_state.source_program_compatibility_range: Dockrev 0.81.x databases upgraded by the candidate application; earlier minor versions are not required to interpret the new audit table or missing-state semantics.

calculation_evidence: The public API and persistent-state members are each classified minor; the release-unit maximum is minor.
